app.name: MoodSync
app.tagline: Understand why some days are good and others are bad.

entry.title: Log your day
entry.subtitle: How was your day, honestly?
entry.error_conflict: An entry for this day already exists.
entry.error_too_old: You can only log entries for the last 7 days.

disclaimer.medical: MoodSync is not a medical diagnostic tool. All insights are for personal reflection only.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back.
login.error_unverified: Please verify your email address first.
login.error_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Please try again in a minute.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Privacy-first mood and habit tracker.
register.password_hint: At least 8 characters, one letter and one digit.
register.error_duplicate: This email address is already registered.
register.error_weak_password: The password does not meet the minimum requirements.
register.privacy_note: By registering you agree to the processing of your health data under GDPR Art. 9(2)(a).

check_email.title: Check your inbox
check_email.body: We have sent a verification email to {email}. Please click the link in that email to activate your account.
check_email.ttl_hint: The link is valid for 24 hours.
check_email.spam_hint: Mail not in your inbox? Please check the spam folder.

verify.title: Verify email address
verify.body: Click the button below to confirm your email address and activate your account.
verify.success_body: Your account is now active. You can sign in.
verify.error_body: The link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new verification email.
verify.missing_token: No verification token found in the URL.

resend.title: Resend verification email
resend.body: Enter your email address. If a matching unverified account exists, we will send a fresh verification email.
resend.success: If the email is registered and unverified, a new verification mail has been sent.
resend.error_rate_limit: Too many requests. Please try again in a minute.
